summary: v17 Document Studio (Phase 1+2) verified. 21/21 pytest tests PASSED. All 29-ish layout endpoints work end-to-end (add/move/delete block, add/remove section, page-break, brand-overlay, color-override) and PDF export after page-break still returns a valid PDF. Composer builds real-data-backed documents (company-snapshot, sector-report) with LLM keys empty — no 500s, AI blocks fail gracefully as designed. All intelligence-engine regressions green. UI smoke on 6 screens: 0 console errors. Note: editor UI does not yet surface layout-control buttons — layout ops verified only via API.

integration_issues.issue: Editor screen (/doc-studio → open document) does not visibly expose UI buttons for the new v17 layout ops (add/move/delete block, add/remove section, page-break, brand-overlay, color-override). Backend endpoints all return 200 via API, but no clickable UI wired to them yet.
affected_selectors: editor toolbar / block card action buttons

verified_functionality.layout_add_block: POST /docstudio/documents/{id}/blocks → 200, block visible in subsequent detail.
verified_functionality.layout_brand_overlay: PUT /docstudio/documents/{id}/brand-overlay set + clear → 200 with correct status strings.
verified_functionality.export_after_page_break: PDF export after page-break insertion still returns 200 (>500 bytes).
verified_functionality.composer_company_snapshot: POST /docstudio/compose/company-snapshot?company_id=<real master_id> → 200 with sections populated (real financial/signal data). AI blocks fail gracefully due to empty EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
verified_functionality.engines_regression: stats/view (66050 signals, 160 opportunities), opportunities/view, fragmentation, ratios/catalog, watchlist, admin/iberinform/stats (real=24992), data-providers/health — ALL 200.
verified_functionality.auth_negatives: Docstudio layout endpoints without JWT → 401/403. signal-intelligence/stats/view without JWT → 401/403. fragmentation without / with invalid X-API-Key → 401/403.
verified_functionality.ui_dashboard: Renders with real stats (24.992 empresas, 88 CNAE, 5029 métricas, 150 señales activas). 0 console errors.
verified_functionality.ui_doc_studio: /doc-studio renders: 7 docs, 5 templates, 4 brands, 9 exportaciones. Tabs Generar/Documentos/Plantillas/Marcas all clickable. Opening a document shows sections (Portada, Resumen, KPIs, Conclusiones) plus PDF/PPTX/Guardar buttons. 0 console errors.
verified_functionality.ui_regression_screens: /opportunities (160 oportunidades), /signals (66050 señales), /data-quality (24992 real, 0 sintéticas), /data-providers (Iberinform 24992, BORME 4811) all render, 0 console errors.

action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: wire the v17 layout endpoints into the document editor UI (add/move/delete block, add/remove section, page-break, brand-overlay, color-override buttons on the block cards / section headers / doc toolbar). Endpoints all work; UI-level controls are not yet surfaced.
critical_code_review_comments: docstudio/routes.py is 1127 lines — recommend splitting layout/compose/export/templates into sub-modules (>700 line guideline).
All layout endpoints correctly gated by get_current_user (JWT) and use `_load_doc_or_404` + `_save_layout` helpers (DRY).
MongoDB `_id: 0` projections applied consistently in docstudio; no ObjectId leak observed.
Composer path gracefully handles empty EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (AI narrative returns error block, document still builds) — confirmed via live test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (0 console errors across 6 screens including doc editor)

seed_data_creation: None. Layout tests use an existing document (Informe Sectorial CNAE 62) and are self-cleaning (block added → deleted; section added → deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Docstudio URL path in frontend is /doc-studio (NOT /docstudio). Export endpoints are GET /api/v1/docstudio/export/{id}/pdf and /pptx (NOT /documents/{id}/export). Company-snapshot composer accepts real master_id from master_companies collection (form: mc_xxxxxxxxxxxx). Use pymongo directly for master_ids because /api/v1/master returns a different companies collection with UUID master_company_id (not the mc_* ids that composer expects). Backend runs off supervisor with --reload watching /app/backend, keep integration tests under /app/tests.
